status: frozen before parameter-grid outcomes were generated
holdout_policy: No outcome or trajectory at or after holdout_start may be read until one candidate is frozen.
search_sequence_reason: Same four calendar days across all six compartments, selected without inspecting grid outcomes; balances weather while preserving policy variation.

stage_1.interpretation: effective total roof-vent discharge coefficient including the documented insect net
stage_1.source_bounds: Fernandez et al. 2016, Sensors 16:690, DOI 10.3390/s16050690, reports screened total discharge coefficients 0.148 to 0.374; AGC reports insect-netted roof vents.

stage_2_if_needed.condition: The stage-1 winner fails the full calibration matrix.
stage_2_if_needed.rule: Evaluate the 3 by 3 grid around the frozen stage-1 cDgh winner on the same search sequences, then run exactly one selected candidate on all calibration sequences.

fixed_quantities: published HPS, LED, rail-pipe, grow-pipe, and CO2 capacities
initial LAI 3 because the official crop file does not measure LAI

selection_objective.primary: minimize the maximum RMSE divided by its frozen gate across tAir, rhIn, and co2InPpm, evaluated for pooled data and every compartment
selection_objective.tie_breaker: minimize the mean pooled normalized RMSE across the three channels

full_calibration_check: The selected candidate must be run on all 21 sequences (50 days) and reported pooled, by compartment, and by sequence before any holdout access.
claim_boundary: Calibration success does not establish holdout validity. A single candidate must be frozen before the holdout is opened.
